<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 5"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Precious Alloys](/Feats.aspx?ID=4329) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Talos" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=507" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 53

</column>

---

Choose [cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=375) or [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=379). Your melee unarmed attacks have the special properties of a weapon made of that metal. If you are at least 13th level, you can choose [adamantine](/Equipment.aspx?ID=374) instead of just cold iron or silver.

**Special** You can take this ancestry feat multiple times, choosing a different metal each time.
name: Precious Alloys
